flags.why: Here tua means a round or circuit, rather than the activity of strolling ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/tua%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
The example explains what man means instead of using it as a number.
flags.fix: Quân giặc có một man người. = The enemy army numbers ten thousand men.

flags.why: This fruit name is regional usage in southwestern Vietnam and needs a Southern tag ([source](https://tuoitre.vn/quat-mien-bac-quat-mien-trung-tac-mien-nam-mien-tay-goi-hanh-20180206115519014.htm)).

Hạnh is an everyday fruit name in parts of southwestern Vietnam, so rare misrepresents its local currency ([source](https://tuoitre.vn/quat-mien-bac-quat-mien-trung-tac-mien-nam-mien-tay-goi-hanh-20180206115519014.htm)).
